slug: 兽校开局被强吻我被疯批们娇宠
content_zh:
避雷:
1.不是系统文，系统目前只出现在第一章。
2.暂定是1v7。强制爱，但不是虐文，偏甜宠。
3.全洁。简介标了，但还是有人问。
正文:
【都星际兽世了，就应该光明正大开后宫，人家七个大男人都不介意分享同一个爱人，女主有什么好犹豫的？】
系统一边传剧情，一边吐槽。
“嘿嘿嘿，他们长得真好看。”
简妤十级颜控，盯着系统传送过来的照片瞅了又瞅。
她苍蝇搓手，一张张放大照片，细品男主们的五官。
看痴了，简妤直接口嗨：“山猪吃不了细糠，七个我都觉得不够，得三十个，一个月刚刚好轮完。”
【有三十一号呢？】
“就当放假喽。”
系统激动，觉得自己遇到了知己。
【还是宿主你想得开。一天一个多好，又不是七个一起上。这一届女主太难带了，长那么帅也不行，组织表示很失望。】
简妤鬼迷日眼：“死丫头就是吃太好了，有本事让我演两集，F7来了，都得躲着我走。”
爱到把人囚禁，锁起来，紧紧抱住，不让任何人觊觎。
哇，有点窒息，有点炸裂，有点喜欢～
简妤本身就爱看强制爱小说，对她来说，只要不虐身，一切都是毛毛雨。
不过，现实中遇到，还是得马上报警。

简妤抬了抬眼睛，“我的任务危险吗？”
【你只是个路人甲，没有任务，相当于一块背景板，没人会注意你的。等剧情结束，我就送你回去了，到时候至少两个亿的出演费。】
简妤胆子变肥，提出请求：“不能当女主，那给我挑个好点的路人甲呗，最好可以让我躲在女主附近磕cp的。”
系统盯着简妤完美无缺的脸蛋，若有所思。
【宿主，你先看剧情，我离开一下。】
剧情挺简单的，简妤很快就看完了。
贵族兽校＋雄竞修罗场。
女主叫许见娟，靠自己努力，成功考进了贵族学院。
人设是：一心学习的特招生，极度讨厌有钱有势的人。
因为在迎新会上说出那句：F7有什么了不起的，不过是比别人会投胎罢了。
她开始被全校人欺负。
大冬天，被泼冷水。体育课，被关禁闭。书会不翼而飞，课桌也总是塞满垃圾。
许见娟反抗，引出F7那句：女人，你成功引起了我的注意。
容貌出尘的F1，高冷禁欲的F2。
温柔绿茶的F3，沉稳腹黑的F4。
手段残忍的F5，自私阴狠的F6，以及疯魔病态的F7。
强制、痴迷、变态，他们总有办法让女主自愿走进他们的囚笼。
女主恐惧他们的靠近，厌恶他们高高在上的施舍，却又不得不躲在他们的庇护伞下。
寿终正寝前，她许愿自由，希望下辈子再也不要跟F7纠缠在一起。
简妤看得津津有味，“咦？系统，怎么变得鼻青脸肿的？”

【不重要，你准备一下，我给你传送。】
系统难得遇到跟自己有共识的宿主。
偷偷跑去跟主系统打了一架，成功为简妤争取到了重生副本。
女主是重生的，且重生在还没跟F7碰面之前。
前世的许愿，端看女主今生如何抉择。
content_en:
Lightning protection:
1. This is not a system article. The system currently only appears in the first chapter.
2. Tentatively it is 1v7. Forced love, but not sadistic, more sweet.
3. Complete cleanliness. The introduction is marked, but people still ask.
Text:
[We are already in the world of interstellar beasts, so we should open up the harem openly. Seven grown men don’t mind sharing the same lover. What should the heroine have to hesitate about? 】
The system is transmitting the plot and making complaints at the same time.
"Hehehe, they look so good-looking."
Jian Yu, who has level 10 face control, stared at the photos sent by the system over and over again.
She rubbed her hands together and enlarged the photos one by one to examine the facial features of the male protagonists.
Frustrated, Jian Yu exclaimed: "Wild pigs can't eat fine chaff. I don't think seven are enough. I need thirty. I can finish the cycle in one month."
[Where is No. 31? 】
"Just treat it as a holiday."
The system was excited and felt that he had met his soulmate.
[It’s up to you to think about the host. One a day is good, but not seven at the same time. This year's heroine is too difficult to lead, even if she is so handsome, the organization expressed its disappointment. 】
Jian Yu was fascinated by the sun: "You damn girl, you just eat too much. If you have the ability, let me act in two episodes. When F7 comes, you have to avoid me."
Love enough to imprison, lock, and hold people tightly, preventing anyone from coveting them.
Wow, it’s a bit suffocating, a bit bursting, a bit like it~
Jian Yu loves to read forced love novels. To her, as long as she doesn't abuse her body, everything is just a piece of cake.
However, if you encounter it in real life, you still have to call the police immediately.
Jian Yu raised her eyes, "Is my mission dangerous?"
[You are just a passerby with no mission. You are just like a background board. No one will pay attention to you. When the plot is over, I will send you back, and you will receive at least 200 million yuan in acting fees. 】
Jian Yu became emboldened and made a request: "If you can't be the heroine, then choose a better passerby for me. It's best if I can hide near the heroine and do cp."
The system stared at Jian Yu's perfect face, thoughtfully.
[Host, you watch the plot first, I’ll leave for a moment. 】
The plot is quite simple, and Jian Yu finished it quickly.
Noble Beast School + Xiong Jing Shura Field.
The heroine's name is Xu Jianjuan, and she successfully entered the aristocratic academy through her own hard work.
The character is: a special admissions student who is dedicated to studying and hates rich and powerful people.
Because I said that sentence at the orientation meeting: What’s so great about F7 is that it is better than others in reincarnation.
She began to be bullied by the whole school.
In the middle of winter, cold water was poured on me. Physical education class, solitary. Books would disappear and desks would always be filled with garbage.
Xu Jianjuan resisted and elicited F7's sentence: Woman, you successfully attracted my attention.
The F1 with an outstanding appearance, the cold and ascetic F2.
The gentle green tea F3, the calm and sinister F4.
The cruel F5, the selfish and cruel F6, and the crazy and pathological F7.
Compulsive, obsessed, and perverted, they always have a way to make the heroine enter their cage voluntarily.
The heroine is afraid of their approach and hates their superior charity, but she has to hide under their umbrella.
Before she died, she made a wish for freedom, hoping that she would never be entangled with F7 again in her next life.
Jian Yu watched with great interest, "Huh? System, how did it become so bruised and swollen?"
[It’s not important, just prepare and I’ll teleport it to you. 】
It is rare for the system to encounter a host that agrees with itself.
He secretly ran to have a fight with the main system and successfully obtained a rebirth copy for Jian Yu.
The heroine was reborn, and she was reborn before she met F7.
The wish made in the past life depends on the heroine's choice in this life.
